title: Bulk Actions for Widgets
text:
## Bulk Actions for Widgets
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000078437
A set of bulk actions is available for custom or brand-new widgets under Toolbox >> Widget Manager . These actions are not available for default widgets.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180346810/original/aVi4EoKGQ-5-fIjmNsGntlgoNhH0NyHm2A.png?1781292197 | alt: ]
The available bulk actions are Delete , Enable , and Disable :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180346734/original/w8StXTxDYFUHKz3yrhMXBr8bLYncsRnb2Q.png?1781292165 | alt: ]
NOTE: Bulk Delete permanently removes the selected widgets and cannot be undone. If the goal is to deactivate widgets while keeping them available for future use, use Disable instead — see How To Disable a Widget .
To perform a bulk action on widgets:
1. Select all widgets using the select-all checkbox shown below:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180346895/original/XzAZJhEIsYqc6Ak-lbClpecCd9xGAkCS5w.png?1781292238 | alt: ]
Or select the widgets individually:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180346944/original/qnKfYo5FKO70iI7GbiIJQBEXt8cXQXeMuw.png?1781292270 | alt: ]
2. Select one of the available bulk actions and click Apply :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180347007/original/UdtJLg4CevUEe1EKIu02ARbHV5lWGJJ5QA.png?1781292311 | alt: ]
3. Once clicked, a confirmation pop-up will appear:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180347043/original/gtf8zjKPYtAc4e1jiXeSQYxQh1dnjeOKvQ.png?1781292331 | alt: ]
4. Once confirmed, the selected bulk action is applied to the selected widgets:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180347105/original/q76EzhJ4zh9fM68dHpWUV48uRG8W6QPZ4w.png?1781292364 | alt: ]
